card.title: Dust and Diesel
card.lyrics:
[verse]
Two hundred miles of nothing and a radio
Playing something that my mother used to know
[chorus]
Dust and diesel dust and diesel
That's the smell of getting gone
Dust and diesel dust and diesel
Wake me when the night is done
card.note: Vocal named once and not described further - measured recipe: naming takes intelligibility 10%% -> 90%%, describing the mix drops it to 30%%.
